roles.description: Working as a Full Stack Developer at Cronix, building scalable, secure, and production-ready web applications across frontend and backend. Developed responsive and reusable frontend components, implemented application flows, integrated REST APIs, handled authentication-based features, managed API-driven state, and worked closely with backend/database workflows to deliver complete end-to-end solutions. Technical responsibilities included building modern frontend applications using React.js, Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS; creating reusable, maintainable, and performance-focused UI components; integrating REST APIs with proper loading, error, and success handling; managing frontend state, form validation, protected routes, and user-based flows; working with backend APIs, authentication, authorization, and database-driven features; and debugging production issues, optimizing performance, and improving application reliability.

Designing and building high-performance, scalable web applications for a diverse range of global brands. I specialize in architecting modern front-end experiences and robust back-end systems that drive measurable business growth. Key Technical Contributions: Lead Full-Stack Development using modern technologies (React, Vite, Framer Motion, and Tailwind CSS | Node.js (Express), PostgreSQL, etc.), designed scalable technical architectures, and maintained engineering excellence to ensure superior technology delivery.
Started as a Frontend Developer Intern, building responsive UI components, improving existing pages, and learning real-world development workflows.
Internship extended based on performance. Contributed to major features, optimized performance, and worked closely with senior developers to solve production-level problems.

Promoted to Full-Time Frontend Developer. Built scalable modules, implemented reusable components, improved page performance, and delivered key production features in collaboration with design and backend teams.

Worked as a Frontend Developer Intern, gaining hands-on experience by contributing to responsive web applications, implementing UI components using React.js and Tailwind CSS, and integrating APIs. This internship helped strengthen my real-world development skills and gave me exposure to production-ready workflows.
